shots.visual_description: Close-up of a model's face under harsh, uneven lighting, highlighting dullness and minor spots on one side. Camera slightly pushes in on the problematic area.
shots.narration: 你的脸是不是总看起来暗沉无光，甚至肤色不均？

shots.visual_description: Product hero shot: The whitening face cream jar sits elegantly on a marble surface, rotating slowly with a soft, warm glow emanating from behind. Focus on its luxurious texture.
shots.narration: 别担心，这款美白面霜，就是你肌肤焕白的秘密武器！
shots.text_overlay: 美白面霜 | 焕白新生

shots.visual_description: Close-up of elegant hands gently applying the white, creamy product onto one side of a model's clean face. Natural, bright lighting. Emphasize the smooth application.
shots.narration: 轻柔涂抹，冰淇淋般质地瞬间融化，精华直达肌底，滋润不粘腻。
shots.text_overlay: 轻盈质地 深度滋养

shots.visual_description: A macro close-up of the skin on the applied side, showing a subtle, immediate hydrated glow. Focus on improved texture and initial brightness. Soft, even lighting.
shots.narration: 坚持使用，你会发现肌肤在悄悄变白，透出自然光泽，由内而外提亮。
shots.text_overlay: 持续焕白 细腻柔滑

shots.visual_description: Split-screen before/after comparison. Left side: dull, uneven skin. Right side: visibly brighter, more even, radiant skin. Model smiles confidently. Bright, studio lighting.
shots.narration: 看！左右脸的鲜明对比，美白效果肉眼可见，自信光芒即刻绽放！
shots.text_overlay: Before VS After 真实对比

shots.visual_description: Product array with the main jar prominently displayed, surrounded by fresh, dewy elements (e.g., water droplets, petals). A clear price tag and '限时优惠' overlay. Warm, inviting lighting.
shots.narration: 别再犹豫！点击下方链接，限时优惠，马上拥有白皙透亮的梦幻美肌！

winning_patterns: 实验对比: 左右脸对比/素颜vs上妆，视觉冲击力强
成分党: 用显微镜/实验室画面展示核心成分
反常识: '千万别这样涂面霜' 引发好奇
hook_strategies: 制造视觉冲击，引发用户好奇心
通过专业知识，建立信任感
提出颠覆性观点，吸引用户停留
content_structures: 痛点切入→产品亮相→上脸实测→效果对比→限时优惠
反常识开场→真相揭秘→产品介绍→使用教程→before/after
emotional_triggers: 焦虑感(皮肤问题，如暗沉、斑点)
期待感(变美，拥有白皙透亮肌肤)
信任感(成分安全、实验证明)
紧迫感(限时优惠、不容错过)

market_summary.summary: 美白面霜市场竞争激烈，消费者普遍面临肤色暗沉、不均、斑点等困扰，渴望安全、高效且有科学依据的美白解决方案。用户对产品成分透明度和真实效果的关注度日益提升。
key_findings: 消费者追求快速且持久的美白效果
对产品成分的安全性及功效有较高要求
真实的用户反馈和实验对比是重要的购买驱动力
